name: Greater Noida West
intro: Mostly homes so far, with commercial land opening up in Knowledge Park 5 and along the 130 m road. The metro question decides a lot here, so we track it from sources, not brochures.
published: NH 24 and the FNG Expressway are about 5 minutes from Sector 16B, according to the London Mart listing. We have not timed it yet.

name: Noida
intro: Sector 43 sits inside the older, built-up Noida grid, near the DND Flyway and the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway, as the Godrej Woods material describes.
published: Road access to the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway and DND Flyway, as published for Godrej Woods. Routes and times not yet measured by us.

name: Greater Noida
intro: Planned sectors, wide roads and Pari Chowk at the centre. The airport at Jewar is now operating, which changes the map for this side of the region.
published: Pari Chowk, Delta metro station, the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway and the Yamuna Expressway are listed as nearby for Sector 27.

name: South Delhi
intro: Chhattarpur and Satbari sit on the edge of the Aravalli green belt, between Mehrauli-Gurugram Road and Vasant Kunj.
published: Developer-published distances: about 4 km to Mehrauli-Gurugram Road, 14 km to IGI Airport. Not yet measured by us.

name: Kainchi Dham, Uttarakhand
intro: Pine hills in Nainital district, known for the Kainchi Dham ashram. Second homes here come with a land law that every outside buyer should read first.
